reviewer: GPT-6 Astra manager; independent GPT-6 Astra localization review

scenes.location: Atraia equipment, hangar and development lists
scenes.storyState: Accessible from the acquired ship bridge; individual entries remain subject to the original IQ and cost logic.
scenes.purpose: Translate the complete potential development-name union without an arbitrary grinding or availability cap.
evidence: docs/r03-qa-source-inventory.md; original item and ship-name tables, guarded exact aliases, and development-loop consumers.
uncertainty: Potential high-threshold names are translated conservatively; no unlock conditions are changed.
Provisional proper names and ambiguous Night/Knight and Task/Tusk readings are recorded per term.
notes: 280 scanned IDs deduplicate to 238 original strings; 18 existing R01/R02 strings are reused and 220 new names are in this group.
Normal and ship Zaizer Cannon are distinct records with source-supported identical names.
All writable storage excludes prior translated pools and numeric progression data.
scenes.reviewNote: Manager translated all 220 source labels; independent Astra localizer reviewed every canonical/display pair. Six recommended canonical/display corrections and seven readability improvements were applied, with unresolved phonetic names explicitly retained as provisional. RE independently approved the QA-authored storage/alias adapter.
